text:
maya: Heads up — I'm seeing a spike in stale aggregates for hourly_metrics between 03:00–05:00 UTC. Might be late S3 partitions. Thinking a small targeted reprocess with a smoothing policy. Who can triage?

jon: on it. rough scale?

maya: ~2.1M keys, ~350k agg rows. Console cost est ~4 GPU-hrs if we run naive full reprocess.

tiago: I'd prefer using priority_smoothing so we don't preempt other backfills. Can the console surface that flag?

lucy: PR open — adds priority_weight + smoothing_window to the reprocess modal. behind ff.

maya: nice. want a dry-run first to surface deltas and catch schema drift.

jon: agreed. runbook: dry-run -> canary 2% -> 10% -> full. need cost estimate + rollback hook for each step.

maya: CLI for dry-run:

```
replayctl run --job hourly_metrics --start 2026-03-19T03:00Z --end 2026-03-19T05:00Z --dry-run --flags "priority_weight=0.5,smoothing_window=30"
```

jon: note — dry-run doesn't reserve quota. ops should monitor quota burn.

lucy: UI shows cost est but add note: "estimate excludes KV cache warmup" — will update modal text.

ops-bot: notice: scheduled maintenance window tonight 02:00–06:00 UTC. Reprocess jobs hitting maintenance will be auto-paused.

jon: kicking off dry-run now. job id 2026032101. will paste logs here.

jon: dry-run result summary: 2.1M keys scanned, output delta small, no schema diffs. peak queue len 8, avg throughput 1.8k recs/s. replayer-03 saw CPU spike.

maya: ok go to canary 2% using smoothing_window=45 and priority_weight=0.4. add preflight alert to monitoring.

lucy: added dashboard panel: query = `sum(replay_backfill_errors{job="hourly_metrics"}) by (stage)` and panels for kv_cache_hit_rate, replayer_cpu.

tiago: remember to tag run so console links show in customer-facing telemetry dashboards.

maya: set dedupe_window=7d to avoid double counting late out-of-order events. Also enable auto-rollback on error for canary.

jon: canary started -> job id 2026032102. tagging @maya @lucy. cost so far ~0.07 GPU-hrs.

lucy: seeing ~0.2% diff in totals vs expected — within tolerance :thumbsup:. no error spike.

maya: schedule 10% ramp tomorrow 03:00 UTC if stable. keep auto-rollback. add kv cache prime step in runbook.

tiago: left comment on console PR: rename "smoothing window" -> "priority smoothing duration" for clarity.

jon: moved remainder to low-priority slots after 05:30 UTC to avoid peak.

lucy: will add run links + job ids to incidentary doc and close loop.

maya: thanks all — plan looks good. follow-up checklist: update console copy, add preflight alert, confirm quota bump for dedicated tenants if cost exceeds threshold, and post final run metrics tomorrow morning.
